name: Hookr
blurb: No-code Hook Blocks (anti-snipe, auto burn, LP rewards, dynamic fees). Pick, tune, remix, deploy own hook in one tx. 21 new blocks added Oct 2026; first community hook already onchain. Codemen launches ship with Hookr blocks.

name: Bunni v2
blurb: First DEX built on Uniswap v4. Programmable liquidity with rehypothecation hook. CAUTION: $8M+ exploit Sep 2025 via Liquidity Distribution Function precision bug — research audit status before LP.

name: Claus
hook_type: Uniswap v4 pool hook (self-rewriting, NFT fee share)
blurb: AI agent token that rewrites its own v4 hooks (13 rewrites during Oct dip). 0.35% of eligible ETH volume to NFT holders (~$11k first 24h payout). Fee-funded buyback/burn + weather-dependent burn-vs-liquidity split.

name: Programmable ($V4)
blurb: Infra for creating/launching customizable tokens with v4 hooks. $V4 trades as a bet on hook-based launches catching on (reported run ~$447k to $7M).

name: Rallypad
blurb: Hook launchpad for humans + AI agents. Coins open as a real pool shaped like a bonding curve, break out into unpullable liquidity. ~$5 to launch, no presale.

name: Fairlaunch
hook_type: Uniswap v4 + Pancake Infinity (dual-engine swap tax)
blurb: Swap tax runs on two engines: Uniswap V4 and PancakeSwap Infinity (the engine under SushiSwap V4). Same hook logic, same quote-leg tax, same holder/creator split across chains.

name: Unipeg
hook_type: Uniswap v4 pool hook (onchain objects, NFT fees)
blurb: Onchain objects built on Uniswap v4. Its NFT fee mechanism inspired $CLAUS. Reference implementation for fee-sharing hooks.

name: Ballast
hook_type: Uniswap v4 pool hook (reserve-backed, fee in hook)
blurb: Reserve layer for tokens: launch on programmable reserves of stocks, ETFs, stables, crypto. Pair is a stock, fee lives in the hook, creator decides where it goes.

name: UHI10 Hookathon winners
blurb: Uniswap Hook Incubator UHI10 (Atrium Academy, Sep 2026). Winners: Markout ($1k, 24s-memory hook), Haze (sandwich-flag + Chainlink VRF settlement), Impact Rebated Fees (deposit-refund oracle), Cronstream (time-weighted USDC LP streaming). Prototypes on canonical Sepolia.

name: Hooked (Hoookedpad)
hook_type: Token-2022 transfer hook (rules in the token)
blurb: Solana-native: rules written into token transfers via Token-2022 transfer hook (not pool callbacks like EVM). Launchers pick buy/sell caps, burns, SOL holder payouts, creator fees. Own token program + DEX + launchpad; ~597 hook-launched tokens observed Oct 2026.

name: PancakeSwap Infinity
hook_type: PancakeSwap Infinity hooks (dynamic fees, shared inventory)
blurb: Infinity = Pancake's v4-style hook engine (also under SushiSwap V4). Dynamic fees, fee-discount hooks, shared-inventory hook live on 10 bStocks pools. CAKE emission program: hook-enabled LPs earn rewards, devs get ecosystem support (up to 1440 CAKE/day).

name: Permapad / Diamond Hand Hook
hook_type: Uniswap v4 pool hook (Diamond Hand Hook via Permapad)
blurb: Permapad launchpad on Robinhood Chain. First graduation Oct 9 2026; launches can attach the Diamond Hand Hook. Earliest hook activity on the new chain.

name: Bordrless ($BORDR)
blurb: Rival Solana standard to Token-2022: own token program where hooks decide the amount (cut, burn, fee, 64B state), not just approve/block. Own DEX + launchpad + SPL bridge + hook SDK. $BORDR ran $2.2M, fell to $300k on founder FUD, back to ~$1.6M.
